select
from COMM_RD_EMPLOYEE C where (c.ARRIVAL_TIME <= #{lastDay} or c.ARRIVAL_TIME is null) and (c.LEAVE_TIME > #{firstDay} or (c.LEAVE_TIME is null and c.empstatus = '0')) and C.EID not in (select eid from ppm.COMM_RD_ATTENDANCE_AUDIT e where TO_CHAR(e.CALENDAR_DATE, 'yyyy-MM') =#{attendanceDate} and e.ATTENDANCE_STATUS = '4')

select #{eid} EID, case when (select distinct 1 from ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE R where R.project_code = t.project_code and r.eid =#{eid} and r.isdisabled = '0') is not null then 1 else 0 end as isChosen, t.pk_id, t.project_code, t.project_name, t.competent_dept, t.sys_no, t.sys_name, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.create_by, t.create_date, t.update_by, t.update_date, t.project_state, t.head_user, t.dev_user, t.deleted, t.participating_dept, t.bus_innova, (select round(sum(BUDGET_AMOUNT),2) from rd_project_contract r where t.PK_ID = r.RD_PROJECT_ID and r.IS_RESEARCH_PROJECT = 'Y' ) BUDGET_AMOUNT, (select LISTAGG(BUDGET_NAME, chr(10)) within group(order by BUDGET_NAME) from rd_project_contract r where t.PK_ID = r.RD_PROJECT_ID and r.IS_RESEARCH_PROJECT = 'Y' ) BUDGET_NAME, t.tech_innova from ppm.rd_project t where t.DELETED='0' and t.PROJECT_STATE in ('1','2') AND ( t.COMPETENT_DEPT =#{depid} or t.PARTICIPATING_DEPT LIKE '%'||#{depid}||'%') order by nvl(t.update_date,t.create_date) desc

select c.eid, c.badge, c.depid, w.location CHARGE_NAME, c.empname username, c.nature, c.empstatus, t.pk_id, t.project_code, t.project_name, t.competent_dept, t.sys_no, t.sys_name, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.create_by, t.create_date, t.update_by, t.update_date, t.project_state, t.head_user, t.dev_user, t.deleted, t.participating_dept, t.bus_innova, (select round(sum(BUDGET_AMOUNT),2) from rd_project_contract r where t.PK_ID=r.RD_PROJECT_ID and r.IS_RESEARCH_PROJECT = 'Y' ) BUDGET_AMOUNT, (select LISTAGG(BUDGET_NAME,',') within group(order by CONTRACT_NAME) from rd_project_contract r where t.PK_ID=r.RD_PROJECT_ID and r.IS_RESEARCH_PROJECT = 'Y' ) BUDGET_NAME, t.tech_innova, (select count(E.EID) from ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE g where g.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE and g.isdisabled = '0' ) as no from ppm.COMM_RD_EMPLOYEE C left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE E on c.eid = e.eid left join ppm.rd_project t on e.project_code = t.project_code left join ppm.comm_rd_department w on (c.depid = w.depid) where t.DELETED = '0' and t.project_state in ('1', '2','3','9') and e.isdisabled = '0' AND c.eid =#{eid}

select d.location charge_name, c.empname username, c.badge, c.nature, c.empstatus, e.isdisabled, t.project_code, t.project_name, (select sum(contract_amount) from rd_project_contract r where t.pk_id = r.rd_project_id) contract_amount, (select count(e.eid) from ppm.rd_project_employee g where g.project_code = e.project_code and g.isdisabled = '0') as no, t.project_state from ppm.comm_rd_employee c left join ppm.comm_rd_department d on (c.depid = d.depid) left join ppm.rd_project_employee e on c.eid = e.eid left join (select pk_id, project_code,project_name,project_state from ppm.rd_project where deleted = '0') t on e.project_code = t.project_code order by e.create_date

SELECT C.DAY_OF_MONTH, C.DAY_OF_CALENDAR, C.MONTH_OF_YEAR, C.YEAR_OF_CALENDAR, C.IS_HOLIDAY, C.CALENDAR_DATE, C.DAY_OF_WEEK, C.EID_CODE, C.ATTENDANCE_TIME, C.ATTENDANCE_STATUS, C.ATTENDANCE_ORNO FROM RD_PROJECT_CONFIG C
C.EID_CODE =#{eidCode} AND
TO_CHAR(c.calendar_date,'yyyy-MM')=#{attendanceDate} AND
order by c.CALENDAR_DATE
